tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything public on hangel (NGOs, events, volunteering, open funding calls, stores, products, library, platform pages) by keyword, in Turkish or English or any other hangel language. Returns matching records with ids for the fetch tool; nextCursor gives further results.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full public record for an id returned by search (for example "ngo:<id>", "event:<slug>", "volunteer:<id>", "fund:<id>", "store:<slug>", "product:<id>", "library:<slug>", "page:/about").

tools.name: search_ngos
tools.description: Find NGOs (associations and foundations) listed on hangel by keyword, city, cause area or minimum transparency score. Each result has a 0-100 transparency score and the link to its hangel profile.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming and ongoing public events organised by NGOs, student clubs and institutions on hangel, optionally filtered by keyword, city or online-only. Each event has a status and its dates in Istanbul time (UTC+3); events that already ended are not returned.

tools.name: list_volunteering
tools.description: List volunteering opportunities on hangel that are still open for applications, optionally filtered by keyword, city, online/remote, or urgent only. Each result has its application deadline and links to the public page where the application is made.

tools.name: list_open_funds
tools.description: List grant and funding calls that are currently open for applications (status, deadline, provider, support amount, focus areas), including Turkish, EU and international programmes. All open calls can be paged through with nextCursor. Applications are made with the provider; hangel only lists the cal

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products from hangel Market partner stores (store, stock status, donation rate, and the price when it was confirmed at the store within the last 21 days; otherwise price is null and priceStatus is "check_at_store").  The donation rate is the approximate share of a purchase made through hangel

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List partner stores on hangel Market with their donation rate (the approximate share of each purchase that reaches the NGOs the buyer chose, after hangel's share and taxes are taken from the commission the brand pays), highest first.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search the hangel civil-society library: legislation, document templates, data and research summaries, academic articles, social impact inventory, books, films and glossary.

tools.name: platform_info
tools.description: What hangel is, who runs it (Social Business Global, a registered association in Istanbul), how donating through shopping works (funded by the commission the brand pays), verifiable trust facts, supported languages, key public pages and library sections. Available in 12 languages.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
